'''''Comet's Wake''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was owned by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kurgan Dala]]. Once while Dala was flying the craft, the ship was boarded by a [[space wraith]], which corrupted Dala's mind.
